rawContent: We don’t buy squash & other bottled drinks to consume day to day at home. We drink water & I usually infuse a jug in the fridge with fruits/mint etc. It’s much healthier for us & the environment. In fact a lot of the day to day changes are also healthier for us. #ClimateChange

I’m far from perfect. I still travel on planes to enjoy holidays. I drive a diesel sport (although it’s an eco edition). At times I over indulge. But at least I try to find realistic & low maintenance improvements that I can make to help #ClimateCrisis

We are so lucky to be living in generation #STEM where there is so much information and technology available to us. However, there is still insufficient drive by governments & investors to change #ClimateChange despite there being positive solutions available to invest in.

@Tesla has been ahead of the game in improving technology in cars & their impact on the environment. Investors & governments could invest significantly more money so they were affordable to all. Instead energy is wasted on finding ways to mock & undermine Musk. #ClimateChange

What makes me the most angry about #climatechange is the ignorance around denial. As a society, we have been warned for decades. This is not a new concept & we have been seeing the consequences for decades. Meanwhile scientists are mocked despite having the highest intelligence.

My aunty was a Trustee for an environmental charity over 25 years ago. Her husband has been a scientist for 3 decades researching fuels. When he tries to have informative conversations with ignorant people they shut him down with the “but you drove here” stupidity. #climatechange

I feel like #ClimateChange conversations are almost as tedious as conversations about equality & fascism. Ethical decent people know it’s wrong & ignorant people will always find a way to undermine the facts/work & take us backwards regardless of the devastating impact. 😩

As individuals we can’t hold the answers to every problem. However, collectively we must never undermine those who are experts in their field & who are fiercely trying to find us positive solutions. Constructive criticism is good but undermining out of ignorance isn’t! #climate
